As of my knowledge cutoff in October 2023, the **2023 Formula One World Championship** was still ongoing. Max Verstappen (Red Bull Racing) held a commanding lead in the Drivers' Championship, while Red Bull was also leading the Constructors' Championship. The final race of the season, the **Abu Dhabi Grand Prix**, typically takes place in early December, so the official results for the 2023 titles might already be decided by now.

For the most recent results, I recommend checking the official Formula 1 website or app. For context, in **2022**, the Drivers' Champion was **Max Verstappen** (Red Bull Racing), and the Constructors' Champion was **Red Bull Racing Honda**.

If you're asking this after December 2023, I encourage you to confirm the 2023 results via real-time sources like:

- Official Formula 1 site: [https://www.formula1.com/](https://www.formula1.com/)  
- Motorsport Stats: [https://www.motorsportstats.com/](https://www.motorsportstats.com/)  

Let me know if you'd like details about previous seasons or specific races!
